title: Blind-Test Capstone
question: How can a model face a fair test without learning the answer in advance?
summary: Define the operator or action, dimensions, boundary conditions, free parameters, calibration data, frozen mapping, held-out observable, null family, uncertainty, provenance, comparison rule, and failure handling before evaluation. Apply one evidential standard across source families without asserting that their theories are equivalent.

caveats: The capstone specifies a future protocol and does not report a completed validation.
